args.message: I added up revenue and credit limits separately, then matched them by region, so each customer's credit limit is counted once however many orders they placed. The credit totals include customers who never ordered. The blank (no-region) row has 16 orders worth 1,193.30 and one customer with no region, whose credit limit is 500.
